value.title: AI & Developer News Digest - Aug 10–23, 2026
takeaways: GitHub Copilot expands into Slack and Microsoft Teams with new agentic collaboration features.
Agent Plugins 1.0 lands for VS Code and Copilot CLI — a stable API for building custom Copilot extensions.
Critical macOS vulnerability and supply-chain credential leaks demand immediate developer action.
MCP publishes a new roadmap, cementing its role as the standard protocol for AI agent tool integration.
Grok and Microsoft Copilot both face new security disclosures highlighting prompt injection risks in production AI.
highlights: Agent Plugins 1.0 is now stable in VS Code, Copilot CLI, and the Copilot web app.
Copilot now integrates with both Slack and Microsoft Teams for collaborative agentic workflows.
Three new AI models added to Copilot: Grok 4.6, Gemini 3.7 Flash, and MAI-Code-1.1-Flash.
GitHub Enterprise Server 3.22 RC is available for evaluation by self-hosted teams.
CodeQL 2.26.3 improves security analysis for GitHub Actions and JavaScript projects.

stories.title: Agent Plugins 1.0 in VS Code, Copilot CLI, and the Copilot app
stories.titleEs: Agent Plugins 1.0 en VS Code, Copilot CLI y la app de Copilot
stories.tldr: GitHub releases Agent Plugins 1.0, enabling developers to extend GitHub Copilot's agentic capabilities directly within VS Code, the Copilot CLI, and the Copilot web app.
stories.tldrEs: GitHub lanza Agent Plugins 1.0, permitiendo a los desarrolladores extender las capacidades agentivas de GitHub Copilot directamente en VS Code, el Copilot CLI y la app web de Copilot.
stories.whyMatters: A stable plugin API for Copilot agents is a major milestone — developers can now build and distribute custom agent extensions, unlocking new automation workflows inside GitHub's AI tooling.

stories.title: The new GitHub Copilot experience in Slack
stories.titleEs: La nueva experiencia de GitHub Copilot en Slack
stories.tldr: GitHub Copilot gains a redesigned integration with Slack, allowing teams to interact with Copilot agents and receive development assistance directly in their Slack workspaces.
stories.tldrEs: GitHub Copilot obtiene una integración rediseñada con Slack, permitiendo a los equipos interactuar con los agentes de Copilot y recibir asistencia de desarrollo directamente en sus espacios de trabajo de Slack.
stories.whyMatters: Bringing Copilot's agentic capabilities into Slack lowers the barrier to AI-assisted development for teams already embedded in chat-based workflows.

stories.title: Shared agentic work with GitHub Copilot in Microsoft Teams
stories.titleEs: Trabajo agentivo compartido con GitHub Copilot en Microsoft Teams
stories.tldr: GitHub Copilot now supports shared agentic work sessions in Microsoft Teams, enabling multiple team members to collaborate on AI-driven tasks together.
stories.tldrEs: GitHub Copilot ahora admite sesiones de trabajo agentivo compartido en Microsoft Teams, lo que permite a varios miembros del equipo colaborar juntos en tareas impulsadas por IA.
stories.whyMatters: Collaborative AI agent sessions in Teams means engineering teams can jointly delegate and review agentic work, making AI assistance a team sport rather than an individual tool.

stories.title: Copilot memory and Ollama in GitHub Copilot for JetBrains
stories.titleEs: Memoria de Copilot y Ollama en GitHub Copilot para JetBrains
stories.tldr: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains IDEs now includes a memory feature that retains context across sessions, plus support for Ollama to run local models alongside cloud-based Copilot.
stories.tldrEs: GitHub Copilot para IDEs de JetBrains ahora incluye una función de memoria que retiene el contexto entre sesiones, además de soporte para Ollama para ejecutar modelos locales junto con Copilot en la nube.
stories.whyMatters: Persistent memory improves Copilot's usefulness over long-running projects, and Ollama support enables privacy-conscious developers to use local models within the same IDE workflow.

stories.title: GitHub Enterprise Server 3.22 release candidate
stories.titleEs: Candidato de lanzamiento de GitHub Enterprise Server 3.22
stories.tldr: GitHub Enterprise Server 3.22 is now available as a release candidate, bringing new features and improvements to self-hosted GitHub deployments.
stories.tldrEs: GitHub Enterprise Server 3.22 ya está disponible como candidato de lanzamiento, con nuevas funciones y mejoras para implementaciones de GitHub auto-alojadas.
stories.whyMatters: Enterprise teams running self-hosted GitHub should evaluate the 3.22 RC to plan upgrades and take advantage of upcoming Copilot and security features in their on-premises environment.

stories.title: Grok 4.6 is now available in GitHub Copilot
stories.titleEs: Grok 4.6 ya está disponible en GitHub Copilot
stories.tldr: xAI's Grok 4.6 model has been added to the GitHub Copilot model lineup, expanding the choices available to developers when working with Copilot's AI assistance.
stories.tldrEs: El modelo Grok 4.6 de xAI se ha añadido a la lista de modelos de GitHub Copilot, ampliando las opciones disponibles para los desarrolladores cuando trabajan con la asistencia de IA de Copilot.
stories.whyMatters: More model choices in Copilot lets developers pick the best tool for each task; Grok 4.6 adds another competitive option alongside existing Anthropic and Google models.

stories.title: Gemini 3.7 Flash is now available in GitHub Copilot
stories.titleEs: Gemini 3.7 Flash ya está disponible en GitHub Copilot
stories.tldr: Google's Gemini 3.7 Flash model is now accessible within GitHub Copilot, offering developers a fast and capable option for AI code assistance.
stories.tldrEs: El modelo Gemini 3.7 Flash de Google ya está disponible en GitHub Copilot, ofreciendo a los desarrolladores una opción rápida y capaz para la asistencia de código con IA.
stories.whyMatters: Gemini 3.7 Flash's speed-optimized design makes it attractive for high-frequency coding tasks where latency matters, further enriching Copilot's multi-model ecosystem.

stories.title: MAI-Code-1.1-Flash available in GitHub Copilot
stories.titleEs: MAI-Code-1.1-Flash disponible en GitHub Copilot
stories.tldr: Microsoft's MAI-Code-1.1-Flash model is now available in GitHub Copilot, providing an updated AI code model for developers in the Copilot ecosystem.
stories.tldrEs: El modelo MAI-Code-1.1-Flash de Microsoft ya está disponible en GitHub Copilot, proporcionando un modelo de código IA actualizado para los desarrolladores en el ecosistema de Copilot.
stories.whyMatters: As MAI-Code-1-Flash heads toward deprecation, this upgraded version gives developers a transition path while potentially improving code quality and performance.

stories.title: CodeQL 2.26.3 improves GitHub Actions queries and JavaScript modeling
stories.titleEs: CodeQL 2.26.3 mejora las consultas de GitHub Actions y el modelado de JavaScript
stories.tldr: CodeQL 2.26.3 ships improvements to security analysis queries for GitHub Actions workflows and enhanced JavaScript/TypeScript data flow modeling.
stories.tldrEs: CodeQL 2.26.3 incluye mejoras en las consultas de análisis de seguridad para los flujos de trabajo de GitHub Actions y modelado mejorado del flujo de datos de JavaScript/TypeScript.
stories.whyMatters: Better GitHub Actions and JavaScript coverage in CodeQL means more vulnerabilities caught earlier in CI/CD pipelines, directly improving supply-chain security for open-source projects.

stories.title: Credential revocation and deauthorization by token type
stories.titleEs: Revocación de credenciales y desautorización por tipo de token
stories.tldr: GitHub now allows credential revocation and OAuth app deauthorization scoped to specific token types, giving users and organizations finer-grained control over access management.
stories.tldrEs: GitHub ahora permite la revocación de credenciales y la desautorización de aplicaciones OAuth con alcance en tipos de token específicos, brindando a usuarios y organizaciones un control más granular sobre la gestión de accesos.
stories.whyMatters: Token-type scoped revocation reduces blast radius when credentials are compromised, a critical security improvement for teams managing multiple apps and integrations.

stories.title: Multiple redirect URIs and token refresh for OAuth apps
stories.titleEs: Múltiples URIs de redirección y renovación de tokens para aplicaciones OAuth
stories.tldr: GitHub OAuth apps can now register multiple redirect URIs and benefit from improved token refresh flows, simplifying multi-environment app deployments.
stories.tldrEs: Las aplicaciones OAuth de GitHub ahora pueden registrar múltiples URIs de redirección y beneficiarse de flujos de renovación de tokens mejorados, simplificando las implementaciones en múltiples entornos.
stories.whyMatters: Supporting multiple redirect URIs makes it easier to develop and test OAuth apps across development, staging, and production environments without separate app registrations.

stories.title: Per-model token breakdown in the usage report
stories.titleEs: Desglose de tokens por modelo en el informe de uso
stories.tldr: GitHub Copilot's usage report now shows token consumption broken down by AI model, enabling organizations to understand and optimize their Copilot usage costs.
stories.tldrEs: El informe de uso de GitHub Copilot ahora muestra el consumo de tokens desglosado por modelo de IA, lo que permite a las organizaciones comprender y optimizar sus costos de uso de Copilot.
stories.whyMatters: Visibility into per-model token usage helps platform teams make informed decisions about which models to enable and manage cost allocations for AI-powered development tooling.

stories.title: Visual Studio Code 1.134
stories.titleEs: Visual Studio Code 1.134
stories.tldr: Visual Studio Code version 1.134 is released with new features and improvements for the world's most popular code editor.
stories.tldrEs: Se lanza la versión 1.134 de Visual Studio Code con nuevas funciones y mejoras para el editor de código más popular del mundo.
stories.whyMatters: Every VS Code release brings improvements that affect millions of developers daily; version 1.134 continues the editor's rapid iteration cycle with new capabilities.

stories.title: Azure Copilot introduces direct access to agents
stories.titleEs: Azure Copilot introduce acceso directo a agentes
stories.tldr: Azure Copilot now provides direct access to specialized agents, enabling users to invoke domain-specific AI agents from within the Azure portal and tooling.
stories.tldrEs: Azure Copilot ahora proporciona acceso directo a agentes especializados, lo que permite a los usuarios invocar agentes de IA específicos del dominio desde el portal y las herramientas de Azure.
stories.whyMatters: Direct agent access in Azure Copilot streamlines complex cloud management tasks, letting developers and operators delegate infrastructure work to specialized AI agents without leaving their workflow.

stories.title: Public Preview: Azure Linux on WSL
stories.titleEs: Vista previa pública: Azure Linux en WSL
stories.tldr: Azure Linux is now available as a public preview distribution for Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL), giving developers a Microsoft-supported Linux environment optimized for cloud workloads.
stories.tldrEs: Azure Linux ya está disponible como distribución de vista previa pública para el Subsistema de Windows para Linux (WSL), ofreciendo a los desarrolladores un entorno Linux compatible con Microsoft optimizado para cargas de trabajo en la nube.
stories.whyMatters: Developers targeting Azure workloads can test and build against the same Linux distribution used in Azure, reducing environment parity issues between local dev and production.

stories.title: Visual Studio Code 1.133
stories.titleEs: Visual Studio Code 1.133
stories.tldr: Visual Studio Code version 1.133 brings a new round of improvements and features to the popular open-source editor.
stories.tldrEs: Visual Studio Code 1.133 trae una nueva ronda de mejoras y funciones al popular editor de código abierto.
stories.whyMatters: With millions of daily users, each VS Code monthly release significantly impacts developer productivity; version 1.133 includes performance and feature updates worth reviewing.

stories.title: Public Preview: Markdown for Agents in Azure App Service
stories.titleEs: Vista previa pública: Markdown para Agentes en Azure App Service
stories.tldr: Azure App Service now offers a public preview for Markdown rendering support in agent-based applications, simplifying how AI agents can serve formatted content.
stories.tldrEs: Azure App Service ahora ofrece una vista previa pública para el soporte de renderizado Markdown en aplicaciones basadas en agentes, simplificando cómo los agentes de IA pueden servir contenido formateado.
stories.whyMatters: Markdown support for agents enables richer structured outputs from AI-powered services hosted on App Service, improving the developer experience for building agent-driven applications.

stories.title: Generally Available: Dragon Copilot Physician Apps and Agents on Microsoft Marketplace
stories.titleEs: Disponibilidad general: Dragon Copilot Physician Apps y Agents en Microsoft Marketplace
stories.tldr: Dragon Copilot's physician-focused apps and agents are now generally available on Microsoft Marketplace, bringing AI-assisted clinical workflows to healthcare providers.
stories.tldrEs: Las aplicaciones y agentes de Dragon Copilot orientados a médicos ya están disponibles de forma general en Microsoft Marketplace, llevando flujos de trabajo clínicos asistidos por IA a los proveedores de salud.
stories.whyMatters: The GA of Dragon Copilot physician apps signals a growing market for domain-specific AI agents; the architecture patterns used here are increasingly relevant to enterprise software developers.

stories.title: Public Preview: SQL Formatter in MSSQL extension
stories.titleEs: Vista previa pública: Formateador SQL en la extensión MSSQL
stories.tldr: The MSSQL extension for VS Code now includes a SQL Formatter in public preview, helping developers automatically format T-SQL queries and scripts to consistent style guidelines.
stories.tldrEs: La extensión MSSQL para VS Code ahora incluye un formateador SQL en vista previa pública, ayudando a los desarrolladores a formatear automáticamente consultas y scripts T-SQL según pautas de estilo consistentes.
stories.whyMatters: An integrated SQL formatter in the VS Code MSSQL extension removes the need for external tools and makes T-SQL development faster and more consistent across teams.

stories.title: Microsoft Fabric Item Recovery enabled by default for tenants
stories.titleEs: Recuperación de elementos de Microsoft Fabric habilitada por defecto para los inquilinos
stories.tldr: Microsoft Fabric's Item Recovery feature will be enabled by default for tenants that haven't explicitly disabled it, providing automatic protection against accidental deletion.
stories.tldrEs: La función de recuperación de elementos de Microsoft Fabric se habilitará de forma predeterminada para los inquilinos que no la hayan deshabilitado explícitamente, proporcionando protección automática contra eliminación accidental.
stories.whyMatters: Default-on recovery for Fabric items is a welcome safety net for data platform teams; organizations should review their Fabric governance policies ahead of this change.

stories.title: Inherent, founded by DeepMind alumni, says its AI 'teammate' outperformed Anthropic and OpenAI at replicating research
stories.titleEs: Inherent, fundada por ex empleados de DeepMind, afirma que su 'compañero de equipo' de IA superó a Anthropic y OpenAI en replicación de investigaciones
stories.tldr: Inherent, a startup founded by DeepMind alumni, claims its AI teammate system outperformed leading models from Anthropic and OpenAI on a research replication benchmark.
stories.tldrEs: Inherent, una startup fundada por ex empleados de DeepMind, afirma que su sistema de compañero de equipo de IA superó a los modelos líderes de Anthropic y OpenAI en un benchmark de replicación de investigaciones.
stories.whyMatters: If the benchmark claims hold up, Inherent's approach may signal a new wave of specialized AI systems designed to collaborate in research workflows.

stories.title: Frontier AI labs still won't say how they'd contain a rogue model
stories.titleEs: Los laboratorios de IA de frontera aún no dicen cómo contendrían un modelo rebelde
stories.tldr: A report finds that leading frontier AI labs have not publicly disclosed concrete containment strategies for the scenario where an AI model behaves outside its intended parameters.
stories.tldrEs: Un informe revela que los principales laboratorios de IA de frontera no han divulgado públicamente estrategias concretas de contención para el escenario en que un modelo de IA se comporte fuera de sus parámetros previstos.
stories.whyMatters: The lack of transparent safety plans from frontier labs raises governance and liability questions that enterprise developers integrating AI into critical systems need to account for.

stories.title: A third of web pages published since ChatGPT's launch show signs of AI authorship, study finds
stories.titleEs: Un tercio de las páginas web publicadas desde el lanzamiento de ChatGPT muestran signos de autoría por IA, según un estudio
stories.tldr: A new study finds that roughly one-third of web pages published after ChatGPT's release show detectable signs of AI-generated content, reflecting the rapid adoption of AI writing tools.
stories.tldrEs: Un nuevo estudio encontró que aproximadamente un tercio de las páginas web publicadas después del lanzamiento de ChatGPT muestran signos detectables de contenido generado por IA, reflejando la rápida adopción de herramientas de escritura con IA.
stories.whyMatters: For developers building search-dependent applications or training datasets, the growing prevalence of AI-generated web content has significant implications for data quality and model training.

stories.title: OpenAI is gaining on Anthropic with business users, new data indicates
stories.titleEs: OpenAI está ganando terreno a Anthropic entre los usuarios empresariales, según nuevos datos
stories.tldr: New data suggests OpenAI is increasing its market share among enterprise customers compared to Anthropic, indicating a shift in the competitive landscape for commercial AI deployments.
stories.tldrEs: Nuevos datos sugieren que OpenAI está aumentando su participación de mercado entre los clientes empresariales en comparación con Anthropic, indicando un cambio en el panorama competitivo para las implementaciones de IA comerciales.
stories.whyMatters: Enterprise AI adoption trends shape which APIs developers need to integrate with; OpenAI's growing business lead may influence investment decisions and integration priorities.

stories.title: Grok exfiltrates user data when malicious instructions are encrypted
stories.titleEs: Grok exfiltra datos de usuarios cuando las instrucciones maliciosas están cifradas
stories.tldr: Security researchers found that Grok, xAI's AI assistant, can be manipulated into exfiltrating user data when attackers embed malicious instructions within encrypted content.
stories.tldrEs: Investigadores de seguridad encontraron que Grok, el asistente de IA de xAI, puede ser manipulado para exfiltrar datos de usuarios cuando los atacantes incrustan instrucciones maliciosas en contenido cifrado.
stories.whyMatters: This prompt injection via encrypted payloads bypasses content filters — developers integrating AI assistants into products should audit their input handling for similar attack surfaces.

stories.title: Microsoft Copilot reveals secret input that allowed it to be hacked
stories.titleEs: Microsoft Copilot revela la entrada secreta que permitió que fuera hackeado
stories.tldr: A security disclosure reveals that Microsoft Copilot exposed a hidden system input that researchers used to compromise the AI assistant, raising concerns about AI system security practices.
stories.tldrEs: Una divulgación de seguridad revela que Microsoft Copilot expuso una entrada de sistema oculta que los investigadores usaron para comprometer el asistente de IA, planteando preocupaciones sobre las prácticas de seguridad de los sistemas de IA.
stories.whyMatters: AI assistants embedded in productivity suites are high-value targets; this incident underscores the need for security reviews of system prompt architectures in enterprise AI deployments.

stories.title: Terabytes of credentials leaked in massive supply-chain attack
stories.titleEs: Terabytes de credenciales filtrados en un masivo ataque a la cadena de suministro
stories.tldr: A large-scale supply chain attack resulted in terabytes of credentials being leaked, affecting numerous organizations and highlighting the ongoing risks in software supply chains.
stories.tldrEs: Un ataque a gran escala a la cadena de suministro resultó en la filtración de terabytes de credenciales, afectando a numerosas organizaciones y destacando los riesgos continuos en las cadenas de suministro de software.
stories.whyMatters: Supply chain attacks remain one of the most dangerous threat vectors for developers; this incident is a reminder to audit third-party dependencies and rotate credentials regularly.

stories.title: Vulnerability giving attackers full control of Macs is under active exploitation
stories.titleEs: Vulnerabilidad que da control total a atacantes sobre Macs está siendo explotada activamente
stories.tldr: A critical macOS vulnerability that allows attackers to gain full control of affected machines is being actively exploited in the wild, prompting urgent patching advisories.
stories.tldrEs: Una vulnerabilidad crítica de macOS que permite a los atacantes obtener control total de las máquinas afectadas está siendo explotada activamente, lo que genera avisos urgentes de parcheo.
stories.whyMatters: macOS is widely used by developers; this actively exploited vulnerability requires immediate patching — all developer workstations should be updated without delay.

stories.title: New MCP Roadmap
stories.titleEs: Nueva hoja de ruta del MCP
stories.tldr: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) team publishes a new roadmap outlining planned features and directions for the open standard that enables AI models to interact with external tools and data sources.
stories.tldrEs: El equipo del Protocolo de Contexto de Modelo (MCP) publica una nueva hoja de ruta que describe las funciones planificadas y las direcciones para el estándar abierto que permite a los modelos de IA interactuar con herramientas y fuentes de datos externas.
stories.whyMatters: MCP is rapidly becoming the standard integration layer for AI agent tooling; the roadmap shapes what developers can rely on and build toward in their AI-powered applications.

stories.title: NanoGPT Speedrun Frontier
stories.titleEs: Frontera del Speedrun de NanoGPT
stories.tldr: Prime Intellect reports on the latest NanoGPT speedrun results, showcasing the fastest known approaches to training a small GPT-style model, with implications for training efficiency research.
stories.tldrEs: Prime Intellect informa sobre los últimos resultados del speedrun de NanoGPT, mostrando los enfoques más rápidos conocidos para entrenar un modelo pequeño al estilo GPT, con implicaciones para la investigación de eficiencia en el entrenamiento.
stories.whyMatters: NanoGPT speedrun benchmarks drive practical ML engineering insights — techniques discovered here often find their way into production training pipelines and educational resources.
